title: Appraisal Order Final Inspection Charge: Borrower's Share for a Late Original Report
content:
## Borrower's share for a late original report — Appraisal Order final inspection charge

The borrower's share of the final inspection charge for a late original report reads the order's fee history and its dates: when the order carries a refund for a missed rush promise and the report was completed 3 days or more after its due date, the borrower pays 50 percent; when it carries such a refund and the report was completed 1 or 2 days after its due date, the borrower pays 75 percent; otherwise the borrower pays 100 percent. The borrower's share is applied once to the final inspection charge after every amount has been added to it and taken off it.

**Terms.** A refund for a missed rush promise is a refund entry in the order's fee history recorded with the reason that the rush promise was missed. The days are calendar days from the due date of the Appraisal Order to its completed date.

| Refund for a missed rush promise in the fee history | Completed date against due date | Borrower pays |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 3 or more days after | 50 percent |
| Yes | 1 or 2 days after | 75 percent |
| Yes | On or before | 100 percent |
| No | Any | 100 percent |

**Worked figures (hypothetical charge of 330.00 before the share).** With such a refund and a report completed 4 days after its due date: 165.00. Completed 2 days after: 247.50. With no such refund: 330.00.
